package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/gorilla/websocket"
	"github.com/labstack/echo/v4"

	"github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/internal/usecase"
	res "github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/pkg/http"
	pkglog "github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/pkg/log"
)

type StatHandler struct {
	service               *usecase.EventService
	summaryService        *usecase.SummaryService
	sessionSummaryService *usecase.LearningSessionSummaryService
	logger                pkglog.Logger
}

func NewStatHandler(service *usecase.EventService, summaryService *usecase.SummaryService, sessionSummaryService *usecase.LearningSessionSummaryService, logger pkglog.Logger) *StatHandler {
	return &StatHandler{
		service:               service,
		summaryService:        summaryService,
		sessionSummaryService: sessionSummaryService,
		logger:                logger,
	}
}

func (h *StatHandler) GetLearningSessionSummary(c echo.Context) error {
	meta, err := readMeta(c.Request())
	if err != nil {
		return res.ErrorJSON(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "bad_request", err.Error(), requestIDFromCtx(c), nil)
	}
	sessionID, err := uuid.Parse(c.Param("session_id"))
	if err != nil {
		return res.ErrorJSON(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "bad_request", "session_id must be UUID", requestIDFromCtx(c), nil)
	}
	result, err := h.sessionSummaryService.Get(c.Request().Context(), meta.UserID, sessionID)
	if err != nil {
		return res.ErrorJSON(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, "cannot_get_session_summary", err.Error(), requestIDFromCtx(c), nil)
	}
	return res.JSON(c, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"summary": result})
}

func (h *StatHandler) StartSession(c echo.Context) error {
	meta, err := readMeta(c.Request())
	if err != nil {
		return res.ErrorJSON(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "bad_request", err.Error(), requestIDFromCtx(c), nil)
	}

	var dto SessionStartRequest
	if err := c.Bind(&dto); err != nil {
		return res.ErrorJSON(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "bad_request", "invalid payload", requestIDFromCtx(c), nil)
	}

	resp, err := h.service.StartSession(c.Request().Context(), meta, usecase.SessionStartRequest{
		CourseID:   dto.CourseID,
		LessonID:   dto.LessonID,
		TaskID:     dto.TaskID,
		Platform:   dto.Platform,
		EditorMode: dto.EditorMode,
		ClientTS:   dto.ClientTS,
		Payload:    dto.Payload,
	})
	if err != nil {
		status := http.StatusInternalServerError
		if errors.Is(err, usecase.ErrInvalidInput) {
			status = http.StatusBadRequest
		}
		return res.ErrorJSON(c, status, "cannot_start_session", err.Error(), requestIDFromCtx(c), nil)
	}

	return res.JSON(c, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"session_id": resp.SessionID,
		"started_at": resp.StartedAt.Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
	})
}

func (h *StatHandler) PostEvents(c echo.Context) error {
	meta, err := readMeta(c.Request())
	if err != nil {
		return res.ErrorJSON(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "bad_request", err.Error(), requestIDFromCtx(c), nil)
	}

	var dto EventsBatchRequest
	if err := c.Bind(&dto); err != nil {
		return res.ErrorJSON(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "bad_request", "invalid payload", requestIDFromCtx(c), nil)
	}

	batch := usecase.EventsBatchRequest{
		CourseID:   dto.CourseID,
		LessonID:   dto.LessonID,
		TaskID:     dto.TaskID,
		Platform:   dto.Platform,
		EditorMode: dto.EditorMode,
	}
	for _, ev := range dto.Events {
		batch.Events = append(batch.Events, usecase.IncomingEvent{
			EventID:    ev.EventID,
			SessionID:  ev.SessionID,
			EventType:  ev.EventType,
			EditorMode: ev.EditorMode,
			Platform:   ev.Platform,
			ClientTS:   ev.ClientTS,
			Payload:    ev.Payload,
			CourseID:   ev.CourseID,
			LessonID:   ev.LessonID,
			TaskID:     ev.TaskID,
		})
	}

	accepted, err := h.service.PublishBatch(c.Request().Context(), meta, batch)
	if err != nil {
		status := http.StatusInternalServerError
		if errors.Is(err, usecase.ErrInvalidInput) {
			status = http.StatusBadRequest
		}
		return res.ErrorJSON(c, status, "cannot_publish_events", err.Error(), requestIDFromCtx(c), nil)
	}

	return res.JSON(c, http.StatusAccepted, map[string]any{"accepted": accepted})
}

func (h *StatHandler) EventsWS(c echo.Context) error {
	meta, err := readMeta(c.Request())
	if err != nil {
		return c.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, map[string]string{"error": err.Error()})
	}

	conn, err := upgrader.Upgrade(c.Response(), c.Request(), nil)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { _ = conn.Close() }()

	for {
		_, msg, err := conn.ReadMessage()
		if err != nil {
			return nil
		}

		base := wsBaseMessage{}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(msg, &base); err != nil {
			_ = conn.WriteJSON(map[string]string{"error": "invalid message"})
			continue
		}

		switch base.Type {
		case "session_start":
			var start wsSessionStartMessage
			if err := json.Unmarshal(msg, &start); err != nil {
				_ = conn.WriteJSON(map[string]string{"error": "invalid session_start message"})
				continue
			}
			resp, err := h.service.StartSession(c.Request().Context(), meta, usecase.SessionStartRequest{
				CourseID:   start.CourseID,
				LessonID:   start.LessonID,
				TaskID:     start.TaskID,
				Platform:   start.Platform,
				EditorMode: start.EditorMode,
				ClientTS:   start.ClientTS,
				Payload:    start.Payload,
			})
			if err != nil {
				h.logger.Error().Err(err).Msg("failed to start session over ws")
				_ = conn.WriteJSON(map[string]string{"error": err.Error()})
				continue
			}
			_ = conn.WriteJSON(map[string]any{
				"type":       "session_started",
				"session_id": resp.SessionID,
				"started_at": resp.StartedAt.Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
			})
		case "events_batch":
			var batch wsEventsBatchMessage
			if err := json.Unmarshal(msg, &batch); err != nil {
				_ = conn.WriteJSON(map[string]string{"error": "invalid events_batch message"})
				continue
			}
			events := usecase.EventsBatchRequest{
				CourseID:   batch.CourseID,
				LessonID:   batch.LessonID,
				TaskID:     batch.TaskID,
				Platform:   batch.Platform,
				EditorMode: batch.EditorMode,
			}
			for _, ev := range batch.Events {
				events.Events = append(events.Events, usecase.IncomingEvent{
					EventID:    ev.EventID,
					SessionID:  ev.SessionID,
					EventType:  ev.EventType,
					EditorMode: ev.EditorMode,
					Platform:   ev.Platform,
					ClientTS:   ev.ClientTS,
					Payload:    ev.Payload,
					CourseID:   ev.CourseID,
					LessonID:   ev.LessonID,
					TaskID:     ev.TaskID,
				})
			}
			accepted, err := h.service.PublishBatch(c.Request().Context(), meta, events)
			if err != nil {
				h.logger.Error().Err(err).Msg("failed to publish events over ws")
				_ = conn.WriteJSON(map[string]string{"error": err.Error()})
				continue
			}
			_ = conn.WriteJSON(map[string]any{
				"type":     "events_accepted",
				"accepted": accepted,
			})
		default:
			_ = conn.WriteJSON(map[string]string{"error": "unsupported message type"})
		}
	}
}

func (h *StatHandler) GetTaskSummary(c echo.Context) error {
	meta, err := readMeta(c.Request())
	if err != nil {
		return res.ErrorJSON(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "bad_request", err.Error(), requestIDFromCtx(c), nil)
	}
	taskID, err := uuid.Parse(c.Param("task_id"))
	if err != nil {
		return res.ErrorJSON(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "bad_request", "task_id must be UUID", requestIDFromCtx(c), nil)
	}

	courseID, err := parseUUIDQuery(c, "course_id")
	if err != nil {
		return res.ErrorJSON(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "bad_request", "course_id must be UUID", requestIDFromCtx(c), nil)
	}
	lessonID, err := parseUUIDQuery(c, "lesson_id")
	if err != nil {
		return res.ErrorJSON(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "bad_request", "lesson_id must be UUID", requestIDFromCtx(c), nil)
	}
	from, err := parseTimeQuery(c, "from")
	if err != nil {
		return res.ErrorJSON(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "bad_request", "from must be RFC3339 timestamp", requestIDFromCtx(c), nil)
	}
	to, err := parseTimeQuery(c, "to")
	if err != nil {
		return res.ErrorJSON(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "bad_request", "to must be RFC3339 timestamp", requestIDFromCtx(c), nil)
	}

	summary, err := h.summaryService.GetTaskSummary(c.Request().Context(), usecase.SummaryFilter{
		UserID:   meta.UserID,
		CourseID: courseID,
		LessonID: lessonID,
		TaskID:   &taskID,
		From:     from,
		To:       to,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return res.ErrorJSON(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, "cannot_get_summary", err.Error(), requestIDFromCtx(c), nil)
	}
	if summary == nil {
		return res.JSON(c, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"summary": nil})
	}

	return res.JSON(c, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"summary": map[string]any{
			"task_id":                  summary.TaskID,
			"started_at":               summary.StartedAt,
			"ended_at":                 summary.EndedAt,
			"session_count":            summary.SessionCount,
			"typing_events":            summary.TypingEvents,
			"total_duration_seconds":   summary.TotalDurationSeconds,
			"reading_duration_seconds": summary.ReadingDurationSecond,
			"solving_duration_seconds": summary.SolvingDurationSecond,
			"avg_duration_seconds":     summary.AvgDurationSeconds,
		},
	})
}

func (h *StatHandler) ListTaskSummaries(c echo.Context) error {
	meta, err := readMeta(c.Request())
	if err != nil {
		return res.ErrorJSON(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "bad_request", err.Error(), requestIDFromCtx(c), nil)
	}

	courseID, err := parseUUIDQuery(c, "course_id")
	if err != nil {
		return res.ErrorJSON(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "bad_request", "course_id must be UUID", requestIDFromCtx(c), nil)
	}
	lessonID, err := parseUUIDQuery(c, "lesson_id")
	if err != nil {
		return res.ErrorJSON(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "bad_request", "lesson_id must be UUID", requestIDFromCtx(c), nil)
	}
	taskID, err := parseUUIDQuery(c, "task_id")
	if err != nil {
		return res.ErrorJSON(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "bad_request", "task_id must be UUID", requestIDFromCtx(c), nil)
	}
	from, err := parseTimeQuery(c, "from")
	if err != nil {
		return res.ErrorJSON(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "bad_request", "from must be RFC3339 timestamp", requestIDFromCtx(c), nil)
	}
	to, err := parseTimeQuery(c, "to")
	if err != nil {
		return res.ErrorJSON(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "bad_request", "to must be RFC3339 timestamp", requestIDFromCtx(c), nil)
	}

	limit := 20
	offset := 0
	if raw := c.QueryParam("limit"); raw != "" {
		if parsed, parseErr := strconv.Atoi(raw); parseErr == nil {
			limit = parsed
		}
	}
	if raw := c.QueryParam("offset"); raw != "" {
		if parsed, parseErr := strconv.Atoi(raw); parseErr == nil {
			offset = parsed
		}
	}

	summaries, err := h.summaryService.ListTaskSummaries(c.Request().Context(), usecase.SummaryFilter{
		UserID:   meta.UserID,
		CourseID: courseID,
		LessonID: lessonID,
		TaskID:   taskID,
		From:     from,
		To:       to,
	}, limit, offset)
	if err != nil {
		return res.ErrorJSON(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, "cannot_list_summaries", err.Error(), requestIDFromCtx(c), nil)
	}

	items := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(summaries))
	for _, summary := range summaries {
		items = append(items, map[string]any{
			"task_id":                  summary.TaskID,
			"started_at":               summary.StartedAt,
			"ended_at":                 summary.EndedAt,
			"session_count":            summary.SessionCount,
			"typing_events":            summary.TypingEvents,
			"total_duration_seconds":   summary.TotalDurationSeconds,
			"reading_duration_seconds": summary.ReadingDurationSecond,
			"solving_duration_seconds": summary.SolvingDurationSecond,
			"avg_duration_seconds":     summary.AvgDurationSeconds,
		})
	}

	return res.JSON(c, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"items":  items,
		"limit":  limit,
		"offset": offset,
	})
}

var upgrader = websocket.Upgrader{
	CheckOrigin: func(r *http.Request) bool { return true },
}

func readMeta(r *http.Request) (usecase.RequestMeta, error) {
	userIDStr := r.Header.Get("X-User-Id")
	role := r.Header.Get("X-User-Role")
	language := r.Header.Get("X-Language")

	userID, err := uuid.Parse(userIDStr)
	if err != nil {
		return usecase.RequestMeta{}, errors.New("X-User-Id header is required and must be a UUID")
	}
	if role == "" {
		return usecase.RequestMeta{}, errors.New("X-User-Role header is required")
	}

	return usecase.RequestMeta{
		UserID:   userID,
		Role:     role,
		Language: language,
	}, nil
}

func requestIDFromCtx(c echo.Context) string {
	if reqID := c.Response().Header().Get(echo.HeaderXRequestID); reqID != "" {
		return reqID
	}
	return c.Request().Header.Get(echo.HeaderXRequestID)
}

type wsBaseMessage struct {
	Type string `json:"type"`
}

type wsSessionStartMessage struct {
	Type string `json:"type"`
	SessionStartRequest
}

type wsEventsBatchMessage struct {
	Type string `json:"type"`
	EventsBatchRequest
}

func parseUUIDQuery(c echo.Context, name string) (*uuid.UUID, error) {
	raw := c.QueryParam(name)
	if raw == "" {
		return nil, nil
	}
	value, err := uuid.Parse(raw)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &value, nil
}

func parseTimeQuery(c echo.Context, name string) (*time.Time, error) {
	raw := c.QueryParam(name)
	if raw == "" {
		return nil, nil
	}
	parsed, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, raw)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	utc := parsed.UTC()
	return &utc, nil
}
